title: The Gambat Institute of Medical Sciences Amendment Act 2013

sections.shortTitle: The Gambat Institute of Medical Sciences Amendment Act 2013
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

THE GAMBAT INSTITUTE OF MEDICAL SCIENCES (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2013
THE GAMBAT INSTITUTE OF MEDICAL SCIENCES
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 2013
SINDH ACT NO. XLVI
OF 2013
KARACHI,
THE 1ST NOVEMBER, 2013
AN
ACT
NO.PAS/Legis-B-20/2013-The Gambat
Institute of medical Sciences (Amendment) Bill, 2013 having been passed by the
Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 20th September, 2013
and assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 30th
October, 2013 is hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh to amend the Gambat
Institute of Medical Sciences Act,2005.
Preamble.- WHEREAS it is
expedient to amend the Gambat Institute of Medical
Sciences Act,2005, in the manner hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows:-
1. Short title
and commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the Gambat Institute of Medical Sciences (Amendment) Act, 2013.
(2) It shall come into force at once.
